title: Transfer of a finite idempotent factor through an away isomorphism
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings with $B$ an $A$-algebra and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Let $D\subset B$ be an $A$-subalgebra finite as an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $C$ be an $(A/I)$-algebra and $\Phi:D/ID\cong (A/I)\times C$ an isomorphism respecting the $A/I$ structure maps. Suppose $b,d\in D$, $d^2=d$, $\alpha\in A$ is a unit, $bd=\alpha d$, $D[1/b]\to B[1/b]$ is bijective [def-weil-ring-localization-away], and $\Phi(\bar d)=(1,0)$. For $e$ the image of $d$ in $B$, $A\to B[1/e]$ is integral and the structure map $A/I\to B[1/e]/IB[1/e]$ is bijective.

source.place: Tag 09XI (lemma-characterize-henselian-pair), proof of (5) implies (2), identifying B'₁ with A'₁ and the compatible fibre splitting; details proved directly from Mathlib localization and integral-algebra lemmas; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09XI on 2026-10-12

proof.text: Choose a unit v with value α. The relation bd = αd gives d = b(α⁻¹d), hence b divides d. Apply Localization.awayMap_bijective_of_dvd to obtain the isomorphism D[1/d] → B[1/e]. The map D → D[1/d] is surjective by Away.algebraMap_surjective_of_isIdempotentElem. Therefore F:D → B[1/e] is surjective, and Algebra.IsIntegral.of_surjective transfers integrality of the finite A-algebra D.

Define s:D → A/I as the first projection of Φ after quotient. It is an A-algebra map and s(d)=1. Extend s over D[1/d], then transport along the isomorphism to a map ρ:B[1/e] → A/I. The ideal IB[1/e] is in its kernel, since ρ fixes A-scalars. Hence ρ induces a left inverse of the quotient structure map, proving injectivity.

For surjectivity, represent an element of B[1/e]/IB[1/e] by F(x), using the surjectivity of F. Lift the first coordinate of Φ(x mod ID) to a∈A. Then Φ(d(x-a) mod ID)=(1,0)(Φ(x)-(a,scalar(a)))=0. Thus d(x-a)∈ID; mapping by F, for which F(d)=1, gives F(x)-a∈IB[1/e]. The quotient element is therefore the image of a mod I.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_idempotent_factor_transfer
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (I : Ideal A) (D : Subalgebra A B) [Module.Finite A D]
    (C : Type w) [CommRing C] [Algebra (A ⧸ I) C]
    (Φ : (D ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A D)) ≃+* ((A ⧸ I) × C))
    (hΦ : ∀ a : A, Φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A D a)) =
      (algebraMap (A ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a),
        algebraMap (A ⧸ I) C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a)))
    (b d : D) (hd : IsIdempotentElem d)
    (α : A) (hα : IsUnit α) (hbd : b * d = algebraMap A D α * d)
    (hloc : Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap D.val.toRingHom b))
    (hΦd : Φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ d) = (1, 0)) :
    (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d.1)).IsIntegral ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d.1)))
          (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d.1)) Ideal.le_comap_map)
